rootCauseHypothesis:
The hosting/app likely retains POS state across account switches because the current-order/cart data is stored in a global or persistent client-side cache that is not being cleared when the manager session ends and the waiter session begins. In other words, the waiter is inheriting the manager’s active order from shared state, browser storage, or a reused session/order context. The blank /pos/app/staff route suggests there may also be a deployment/routing issue for staff pages, but the direct test failure is most consistent with stale cart state not being reset on user switch. Underlying error: TEST FAILURE

The waiter session shows items in the Current Order that were added by the manager — the cart was not cleared when switching accounts.

Observations:
- The sidebar shows "Yonas • Head Waiter" and manager-only navigation items (e.g., "Staff", "Amanuel") are not present.
- The Current Order (right panel) lists TEA and Espresso with a Total of ETB 220.
- A prior direct navigation to /pos/app/staff produced no visible staff management content (page was blank), so staff access could not be validated via that route.

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Clear or reinitialize the POS cart/order state on authentication/account switch and on POS app mount for each user session. If the cart is stored in shared client state (e.g., Redux/Zustand/localStorage/sessionStorage), namespace it by user/role or explicitly reset it during logout/login and when the active account changes. Also ensure the server does not persist a previous user’s active order into the next session via cached API responses or a reused session identifier. If /pos/app/staff is intended to exist, confirm the route is deployed and returns the staff-management view for authorized users instead of a blank page.
